### Overall Assessment
This is a highly competent sprint planning facilitation that demonstrates strong Scrum Master fundamentals. The response correctly identified the highest-value work, handled stakeholder conflicts diplomatically, and produced an actionable plan with clear commitments. The balance between respecting constraints and delivering maximum value was well struck, with particularly good handling of the PDF export misestimate and the two-sprint runway for the CEO demo.
